content.title: LSG vs GT Live Score, IPL 2026: Prasidh four-for studs GT's second straight win
content.text: GT won by 7 wickets (with 8 balls remaining)Apr 12, 2026, 8:32 AMSecond straight win for GTPrince Yadav has decided the best way to tackle Washington Sundar is by bowling the short ball into his ribs. Washington sways inside the line and helps him over fine leg for six. He's come out looking to play shots, and that flick shot the he picks away behind square is fast becoming his signature. Washington hits the winning runs to finish with a sweet, little cameo: 21 off 13. GT are home by seven wickets and with eight balls to spare.Apr 12, 2026, 8:18 AMPrince has his revengeThe most impressive of LSG's pacers so far his season has the GT captain. In his first spell, he was smashed on his left thumb by a rocket hit off Gill. He has now come back to remove him with a short ball that Gill gloves to Pant, but not before he has all but sealed the deal for GT.Apr 12, 2026, 8:07 AMA special century for Buttler100 Number of half-centuries for Buttler in T20s. This one's come off just 29 balls as GT are racing towards their targetApr 12, 2026, 7:56 AMGill: fifty and countingGets there off 34 deliveries as GT cruise. Gill has hardly put a foot wrong, taking the attack to LSG's spin twins Rathi & George Linde, the left-arm spinner. This has been a peerless knock so far.Apr 12, 2026, 7:41 AMRathi and a tale of two oversSudharsan has hit a long-hop straight to short fine leg. He looks to swivel around to help it around, the ball gets big on him and ends up picking out Avesh Khan. GT then bring up their fifty in the sixth over as Buttler thumps him through the covers in the same over to end the powerplay.He could've had Buttler in his second over, but the thick edge is put down by Rishabh Pant behind the stumps. How costly will it prove to be? GT 66/1 in the 8th over. Looking at the replays, must say it was a regulation chance.Apr 12, 2026, 7:24 AMShami: back out againRuns in for the fifth over, with no visible discomfort, and gets picked away for back-to-back fours by Gill. A delectable leg glance followed by a straight hit down the ground on the up. So impressive to watch. GT beginning to kick into gear.Apr 12, 2026, 7:20 AMShami off the fieldMidway through his second over, Shami grabs at his left side and calls for physio Patrick Farhart. He completes the over, but walks off looking far from comfortable. His figures: 2-0-10-0.That’s not the only worry for LSG. In the fourth over, Gill drills one straight back at Prince Yadav, who takes a painful blow near his left thumb in his follow-through. Farhart is quickly back out to tend to him.Amid the concerns, GT have begun steadily: 25/0 after four overs.Apr 12, 2026, 6:42 AMShami v Gill143 Gill's strike rate against Shami. He has so far hit him for 76 off 53 deliveries, while being dismissed twice. This will be a contest to look out for. A bowler wanting to prove a point, up against India's Test and ODI skipper.Meanwhile, B Sai Sudharsan gets GT off to a superb start, as he crashes Shami through extra cover off the very second delivery. Three dots later, there's a repeat off the last ball to end a strong first over.Apr 12, 2026, 6:37 AMPrasidh gets a fourthBut guess what?It's another short ball that does the trick. Mukul Choudhary gets a big, fat edge to a slower bumper he tries to pull, taken well behind the stumps by Buttler. Not Mukul's afternoon, but he's quietly contributed 18 off 14 that has helped LSG near 150.Apr 12, 2026, 6:20 AMMukul gets a lifeHe should've been run out third ball. He'd given up, but Ashok Sharma missed a direct hit at the striker's end despite having all three stumps to aim at. One ball later, Mukul top-edges a pull over the keeper's head for four.Whether it's a conscious ploy by GT or not, only time will tell, but Ashok then starts his final over with a 150.2kph bumper that hits Mukul on the head. He's cleared for concussion. Having dug one in, Ashok sticks to the same ploy and has Samad pulling to the lone man at deep midwicket off the next delivery.LSG 118/6 in the 17th overApr 12, 2026, 6:10 AMPooran's laboured stay endsHe makes 19 off 21, with 12 of those coming via two sixes off Rashid Khan. There were brief glimpses of fluency, but the search for rhythm and confidence clearly continues. The end is rather tame: an attempted flat-batted hit off Prasidh finds Gill intercepting it at mid-off. LSG 109/5 in the 15th.Apr 12, 2026, 5:36 AMMarkram - second time unluckyHe got a life early. Markram's flick that should’ve been taken, only for Glenn Phillips to see the ball pop out as his elbow hit the turf after he had covered terrific ground at deep midwicket. Three balls later, though, there’s no escape. Markram goes after a Prasidh short ball again, but this time he picks out deep midwicket to perfection. And it quickly turns into an eerily similar pattern. In Prasidh's very next over, Badoni falls in almost identical fashion, as LSG slump to 74/4 in the ninth.Apr 12, 2026, 5:21 AMSiraj strikes!Sticking to a hard length well into his third over, extracting both seam movement and lift, he keeps asking questions. Rishabh Pant decides to take him on, but the ball climbs, catches the splice, and lobs up towards mid-off where Tewatia steadies himself under it and completes a fine catch. Pant departs for 18, and LSG slip to 45/2 in the fifth.Apr 12, 2026, 5:05 AMWelcome, KagisoAfter a probing first over from Siraj, where he twice beat Aiden Markram outside off, Mitch Marsh wastes no time in shifting gears as he launches Rabada straight back over long-on for six. Rabada responds by dragging his length back, but Marsh survives a scare as a thick inside edge whistles past the leg stump for four. Off the third delivery, Rabada has the final say. Marsh mistimes the loft, toe-ending it straight to mid-off. And then two more boundaries.An over that had a bit of everything.Apr 12, 2026, 4:28 AMBuilding up to double-header SundayShubman Gill called correctly as Gujarat Titans elected to bowl against Lucknow Super Giants at the Ekana Stadium. Both sides are unchanged.Titans pipped Delhi Capitals in a last-ball thriller, while LSG overcame Kolkata Knight Riders on the back of an unreal half-century from rookie Mukul Choudhary.The win gave Titans their first win in three matches, and Gill hoped the team would be able to build on it.“Consistency is one thing we always talk about,” he said. “It’s the most important thing. In the first two matches, the kind of situations we were in, it went down to the wire. Two points in the previous game gives us a bit of relief. Hope to play better cricket.”Pant wasn’t fussed about having to set a target. He felt with the way pitches are, “batting or bowling first won’t matter.”He was particularly pleased with the character LSG have shown in bouncing back to post two straight wins after starting the season with a loss to Delhi Capitals“For us it’s amazing, every win is important. If you win like that, it shows the character of the team,” he said. “It’s a great boost coming in on the back of a win, but this is a new match. Wickets and conditions may be different.“We spoke of intent on the field, it was great to see us put our bodies on the line [in Kolkata].”The XIs Lucknow Super Giants: 1 Aiden Markram, 2 Mitchell Marsh, 3 Rishabh Pant (capt, wk), 4 Ayush Badoni, 5 Nicholas Pooran, 6 Abdul Samad, 7 Mukul Choudhary, 8 Mohammed Shami, 9 Avesh Khan, 10 Prince Yadav, 11 Digvesh RathiImpact bench: M Siddharth, George Linde, Shahbaz Ahmad, Mayank Yadav, Matthew BreetzkeGujarat Titans: 1 B Sai Sudharsan, 2 Shubman Gill (capt), 3 Jos Buttler (wk), 4 Washington Sundar, 5 Glenn Phillips, 6 Rahul Tewatia, 7 Rashid Khan, 8 Kagiso Rabada, 9 Ashok Sharma, 10 Prasidh Krishna, 11 Mohammed SirajImpact bench: Shahrukh Khan, Manav Suthar, Jason Holder, Kulwant Kejroliya, Anuj RawatApr 12, 2026, 4:19 AMGill vs LSG's quicksHow will Shubman Gill fare against LSG's fast bowlers? Well, he has a good record against Shami, with the seamer having dismissed him only twice in seven innings and Gill striking at 143.49 against him.However, it's a more interesting contest when you look at his numbers against Avesh Khan. Avesh has dismissed Gill four times in nine innings and Gill has only struck at 124.56 against him. Will that be a key contest today?Apr 12, 2026, 3:52 AMDecoding Prasidh Krishna's action ft. Dale SteynApr 12, 2026, 3:36 AMShould LSG pick a fourth overseas player vs GT?Apr 12, 2026, 3:18 AMWill Linde get a game straightaway?In case you missed the news from a couple of days back, South Africa allrounder George Linde has replaced the injured Wanindu Hasaranga at LSG for IPL 2026. Linde, a left-arm spin-bowling allrounder, joins LSG at his base price of INR 1 crore. He has played three Tests, four ODIs and 37 T20Is for South Africa.While this will be Linde's maiden IPL stint, he has played in the SA20, the Hundred, Major League Cricket and the PSL in the last 12 months. In 250 T20s, he has taken 218 wickets with an economy rate of 7.42. With the bat, he has scored 2746 runs at an average of 19.47 with a strike rate of 136.68.Apr 12, 2026, 2:49 AMIn the spotlightMohammed Siraj was RCB's go-to powerplay bowler, and for GT he is supposed to be that too. But he had two wicketless overs against Punjab Kings - he did not bowl anymore that day - and across the two games against DC and Rajasthan Royals, his only two wickets of the season came in the 17th and 20th overs respectively. He also conceded 100 in eight overs against RR and DC. When will his first powerplay wicket of IPL 2026 arrive?Runs have been hard to come by for Nicholas Pooran. He has not crossed 17 in 10 of his last 11 T20s, a run extending from the SA20 followed by no cricket in February and March and then across the first three IPL 2026 games. In IPL, he is averaging 7.33 in three games. His dynamic batting makes him tough to drop, but how long a rope will LSG give him?Apr 12, 2026, 2:20 AMWill Holder get a look in?GT are comfortable using five bowlers, with Washington Sundar being used sporadically depending on match-ups. Kushagra or Holder would be tempting options, but otherwise, the team prefers stability in their XIs, and seamer Ashok Sharma could keep his place in the XII.Gujarat Titans XII: 1 B Sai Sudharsan, 2 Shubman Gill (capt), 3 Jos Buttler (wk), 4 Washington Sundar, 5 Glenn Phillips, 6 Rahul Tewatia, 7 Shahrukh Khan/Kumar Kushagra, 8 Rashid Khan, 9 Kagiso Rabada, 10 Ashok Sharma, 11 Prasidh Krishna, 12 Mohammed SirajJason Holder in GT XI?2.7K votesYes - instead of PhillipsMohammed Shami at No. 8 leaves LSG's batting slightly light but with no reliable allrounder in their top eight - Mitchell Marsh hasn't bowled in the IPL in the last two seasons - that's an issue they don't have a real solution for. George Linde, the South African left-arm spinner, has replaced Wanindu Hasaranga in the squad, and if drafted into the XII, his experience could bolster their spin bowling while extending the batting a bit more. M Siddharth could miss out, in that case.Lucknow Super Giants XII: 1 Aiden Markram, 2 Mitchell Marsh, 3 Rishabh Pant (capt, wk), 4 Ayush Badoni, 5 Nicholas Pooran, 6 Abdul Samad, 7 Mukul Choudhary, 8 Mohammed Shami, 9 George Linde, 10 Avesh Khan, 11 Prince Yadav, 12 Digvesh RathiApr 12, 2026, 1:35 AMMukul. Magic.Before anything else, let’s just go back to the last time LSG were in action, and revisit what Mukul Choudhary did that night.From Sreshth Shah: The score read 128 for 7, the target was 182, and Choudhary had only new batter Avesh Khan and two more bowlers to follow as partners. Three misses in four balls off Sunil Narine meant Choudhary had scored just two off six deliveries. The jumbotron in the stadium flashed "54 needed off 24". But what LSG knew, and KKR didn't, was Choudhary is filled to the brim with self-belief: "I try to take the game deep," he said later. "I can win it if I stay till the end."Apr 12, 2026, 1:18 AMWhich team is in rhythm?Both Lucknow Super Giants and Gujarat Titans meet after finishing on the right side of last-ball thrillers against Delhi Capitals and Kolkata Knight Riders respectively. In a tournament moving at breakneck speed and leaving little time for reflection, those are the nights that can have a positive knock-on effect on the rest of their campaign.But that same adrenaline can blur the truth. Reality is that both wins were narrow escapes after far-from-perfect outings. Creases still need ironing out. GT's batting - although consistent - remains stuck somewhere between fourth and fifth gear, potentially due to an undercooked middle and lower-middle order while Mohammed Siraj is lacking incisiveness in the powerplay. Jos Buttler, Washington Sundar and Rashid Khan are steadily getting into form although Kagiso Rabada, Prasidh Krishna and Siraj haven't had the impact GT would like to see.For LSG, Rishabh Pant's batting has been a bit of an issue, with short-ball tactics keeping him quiet, although he has displayed enough fight to overcome that and pace chases better. But he is still not at his fluent best, with Nicholas Pooran also struggling in 2026. The batting is not instilling the fear that they had intended to when LSG stacked up their line-up, even as Ayush Badoni and Mukul Choudhary look in fine touch lower down.That makes this meeting an interesting checkpoint. The adrenaline of last-ball wins can carry a team only so far. This game will show which side is actually in rhythm, and which has just been surviving the margins a little better.LSGGT100%50%100%LSG InningsGT InningsOver 19 • GT 165/3GT won by 7 wickets (with 8 balls remaining)Instant answers to T20 questions
